chunks.phrase: Could I get that to go, please?
chunks.ipa: /kʊd aɪ ɡɛt ðæt tuː ɡoʊ pliːz/
chunks.communicativeIntent: Requesting food or beverage in takeaway packaging politely
chunks.lexicalPattern: Could I get [ITEM] to go, please?
chunks.connectedSpeechNote: 'Could I' links smoothly as /kʊ-daɪ/; 'get that' uses a glottal stop /ɡɛ(t) ðæt/.

chunks.communicativeIntent: Explaining slight time delay without sounding panicked
chunks.connectedSpeechNote: 'bit late' blends together with a suppressed 't'.

chunks.phrase: I'm currently blocked on the deployment pipeline.
chunks.ipa: /aɪm ˈkɜːr.ənt.li blɑːkt ɑːn ðə dɪˈplɔɪ.mənt ˈpaɪp.laɪn/
chunks.communicativeIntent: Signaling an impediment in a sprint or daily sync clearly

chunks.phrase: Let's touch base tomorrow morning on this.
chunks.ipa: /lɛts tʌtʃ beɪs təˈmɔːr.oʊ ˈmɔːr.nɪŋ ɑːn ðɪs/
chunks.communicativeIntent: Proposing a brief follow-up discussion at a later time
chunks.connectedSpeechNote: 'touch base' natural elision on ch-to-b transition.

chunks.phrase: Does that make sense from your end?
chunks.ipa: /dʌz ðæt meɪk sɛns frʌm jʊər ɛnd/
chunks.communicativeIntent: Checking comprehension and inviting alignment without sounding confrontational
chunks.connectedSpeechNote: 'Does that' blends as /dʌz-ðæt/; 'your end' links as /jʊər-ɛnd/.
